title: Facade – Windows (PER)
activity: Windows: opening prep, installation, glazing, vents, sealing, sill and finish
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Precast around the opening complete, Compriband Illmod TP 600 in place?
Window undamaged and clean before fitting, external gaskets in place?
Vent safety check done – vents opened and locking hardware secure?
Window lined, levelled and plumb, on line with its neighbours?
Frame square – diagonals equal; profiles flush at corners?
Window complete with all site-attached parts?
Glass undamaged and clean; kite mark bottom-left viewed from inside?
Glazing beads all fitted and secure?
Leaves adjusted – open, close and lock smoothly?
Window sensor fitted and tested working (where fitted)?
Internal insulation and vapour barrier in and taped around the frame?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – window installation checklist 6.2; PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-09-STK window glazing & finish out 4.1

questions.q: External perimeter seal continuous between frame and precast?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-09-STK window glazing & finish out 4.2; PER ITP 31-0001 – window installation checklist 7.1

questions.q: Sill EPDM/membrane in and sealed, lapped at the ends?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-09-STK window glazing & finish out 5.1

questions.q: Sill screw-fixed to the frame, continuous seal at the top and ends?
questions.source: PER ITP 31-0001 – PUK-QC-09-STK window glazing & finish out 6.1–6.2

questions.q: Outer finishing profiles fitted with safety screws?
No damage inside or out after installation?
Matches the benchmark for this facade type?
